name: UPERGY Societe Anonyme
summary: UPERGY Société Anonyme distributes batteries in France and internationally. The company offers lighting products, industrial packs, rechargeable lead batteries, PMR batteries and chargers, and solar batteries. It provides its products under the Allbatteries, 1001 BATTERY BATTERIES, and Microbatt brands. UPERGY Société Anonyme distributes its products to professionals, individuals, small retailers, large groups, and wholesalers. The company was formerly known as VDI Group Société Anonyme and changed its name to UPERGY Société Anonyme in June 2018. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Champagne-au-Mont-d'Or, France. UPERGY Société Anonyme is a subsidiary of BDR SAS.
